reviews.comment:
Estuvimos desayunando y la verdad lo que es el Full un desastre. No había capuchino porque no tenían crema. Éramos 3 y pedimos 6 medialunas y la más tierna tenía 2 o 3 día de cocinada. Un verdadero desastre. Además de no tener variedad de nada el full.
Realmente una porquería. El dueño debería ver a quien pone a cargo de la estación porque debe ser flor de inútil.

(Translated by Google)
We had breakfast there, and honestly, the Full was a disaster. They didn't have cappuccino because they were out of cream. There were three of us, and we ordered six croissants, and the freshest one looked like it had been baked for two or three days. A real mess. Besides, the Full had absolutely no variety. It was truly awful. The owner should really reconsider who he puts in charge of the station because it must be completely incompetent.
